"f0a8c230-87a3-5723-b85f-4967952af1c4" :question/problem "Use the substitution $u=\tan{\left(x \right)} + 2$. Which integral is obtained?

$$
\int \frac{\sec^{2}{\left(x \right)}}{\tan{\left(x \right)} + 2}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$"] [:db/add "f0a8c230-87a3-5723-b85f-4967952af1c4" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=\tan{\left(x \right)} + 2$. Then

$$
\frac{\mathrm{d}u}{\mathrm{d}x}=\sec^{2}{\left(x \right)}.
$$

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int \frac{\sec^{2}{\left(x \right)}}{\tan{\left(x \right)} + 2}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\int \frac{1}{u}\,\mathrm{d}u.\end{aligned}
$$

The transformed integral is

$$
\int \frac{1}{u}\,\mathrm{d}u.
$$"] [:db/add "f0a8c230-87a3-5723-b85f-4967952af1c4" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/easy] [:db/add "f0a8c230-87a3-5723-b85f-4967952af1c4" :question/answer-fields \int \frac{3 \sin{\left(x \right)}}{\cos{\left(x \right)} + 2}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$"] [:db/add "27c56402-ae7c-5947-a07d-e1f38c987e3b" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=\cos{\left(x \right)} + 2$. Then

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int \frac{3 \sin{\left(x \right)}}{\cos{\left(x \right)} + 2}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=-3\left(\int \frac{1}{u}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

The transformed integral is

$$
-3\left(\int \frac{1}{u}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).

"cb22fcf0-993c-5966-acfa-b01e2aafd293" :question/problem "Use the substitution $u=2 \sec{\left(x \right)} + 3$. Which integral is obtained?

$$
\int \frac{2 \tan{\left(x \right)} \sec{\left(x \right)}}{2 \sec{\left(x \right)} + 3}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$"] [:db/add "cb22fcf0-993c-5966-acfa-b01e2aafd293" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=2 \sec{\left(x \right)} + 3$. Then

$$

$$

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int \frac{2 \tan{\left(x \right)} \sec{\left(x \right)}}{2 \sec{\left(x \right)} + 3}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\int \frac{1}{u}\,\mathrm{d}u.\end{aligned}

$$

$$"] [:db/add "cb22fcf0-993c-5966-acfa-b01e2aafd293" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/easy] [:db/add "cb22fcf0-993c-5966-acfa-b01e2aafd293" :question/answer-fields "a5c5b866-690a-536b-8016-b5bc64541276"] [:db/ensure "cb22fcf0-993c-5966-acfa-b01e2aafd293" :question/validate] [:db/add 17592186068918 :knowledge-point/questions "cb22fcf0-993c-5966-acfa-b01e2aafd293"] [:db/add "9269a841-cb22-57b2-a1b9-ab5722aaacb3" :answer/id #uuid "9269a841-cb22-57b2-a1b9-ab5722aaacb3"] [:db/add "9269a841-cb22-57b2-a1b9-ab5722aaacb3" :answer/type :answer.type/math] [:db/add "9269a841-cb22-57b2-a1b9-ab5722aaacb3" :answer/value "-3\left(\ln\left|\cos{\left(x \right)} + 2\right|\right)"] [:db/ensure "9269a841-cb22-57b2-a1b9-ab5722aaacb3" :answer/validate] [:db/add "36cdbfc0-1dbe-5184-9526-131f920264cf" :answer-field/id #uuid "36cdbfc0-1dbe-5184-9526-131f920264cf"] [:db/add "36cdbfc0-1dbe-5184-9526-131f920264cf" :answer-field/key "answer"] [:db/add "36cdbfc0-1dbe-5184-9526-131f920264cf" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/blank] [:db/add "36cdbfc0-1dbe-5184-9526-131f920264cf" :answer-field/choices "9269a841-cb22-57b2-a1b9-ab5722aaacb3"] [:db/add "36cdbfc0-1dbe-5184-9526-131f920264cf" :answer-field/correct "9269a841-cb22-57b2-a1b9-ab5722aaacb3"] [:db/ensure "36cdbfc0-1dbe-5184-9526-131f920264cf" :answer-field/validate] [:db/add "bfed7b75-cd14-5de2-9aa5-2a0b83a01ce0" :question/id #uuid "bfed7b75-cd14-5de2-9aa5-2a0b83a01ce0"] [:db/add "bfed7b75-cd14-5de2-9aa5-2a0b83a01ce0" :question/problem "Find an antiderivative.

$$
\int \frac{3 \sin{\left(x \right)}}{\cos{\left(x \right)} + 2}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

You may use $\int 1/u\,\mathrm{d}u=\ln\left|u\right|+C$.

{{answer}} $+C$"] [:db/add "bfed7b75-cd14-5de2-9aa5-2a0b83a01ce0" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=\cos{\left(x \right)} + 2$. Then

$$
\frac{\mathrm{d}u}{\mathrm{d}x}=- \sin{\left(x \right)}.
$$

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int \frac{3 \sin{\left(x \right)}}{\cos{\left(x \right)} + 2}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=-3\left(\int \frac{1}{u}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Integrate with respect to $u$:

$$
-3\left(\int \frac{1}{u}\,\mathrm{d}u\right)=-3\left(\ln\left|u\right|\right)+C.
$$

Substitute back:

$$
-3\left(\ln\left|\cos{\left(x \right)} + 2\right|\right)+C.
$$"] [:db/add "bfed7b75-cd14-5de2-9aa5-2a0b83a01ce0" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate] [:db/add "bfed7b75-cd14-5de2-9aa5-2a0b83a01ce0" :question/answer-fields "36cdbfc0-1dbe-5184-9526-131f920264cf"] [:db/ensure "bfed7b75-cd14-5de2-9aa5-2a0b83a01ce0" :question/validate] [:db/add 17592186068918 :knowledge-point/questions "bfed7b75-cd14-5de2-9aa5-2a0b83a01ce0"] [:db/add "1ab35f0d-ed0b-53a6-a709-eee21b017721" :answer/id #uuid "1ab35f0d-ed0b-53a6-a709-eee21b017721"] [:db/add "1ab35f0d-ed0b-53a6-a709-eee21b017721" :answer/type :answer.type/math] [:db/add "1ab35f0d-ed0b-53a6-a709-eee21b017721" :answer/value "- \frac{2}{3}\left(\ln\left|\cos^{3}{\left(x \right)} + 3\right|\right)"] [:db/ensure "1ab35f0d-ed0b-53a6-a709-eee21b017721" :answer/validate] [:db/add "32b8e67e-6266-592b-9ab4-48fe7c1076bd" :answer-field/id #uuid "32b8e67e-6266-592b-9ab4-48fe7c1076bd"] [:db/add "32b8e67e-6266-592b-9ab4-48fe7c1076bd" :answer-field/key "answer"] [:db/add "32b8e67e-6266-592b-9ab4-48fe7c1076bd" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/blank] [:db/add "32b8e67e-6266-592b-9ab4-48fe7c1076bd" :answer-field/choices "1ab35f0d-ed0b-53a6-a709-eee21b017721"] [:db/add "32b8e67e-6266-592b-9ab4-48fe7c1076bd" :answer-field/correct "1ab35f0d-ed0b-53a6-a709-eee21b017721"] [:db/ensure "32b8e67e-6266-592b-9ab4-48fe7c1076bd" :answer-field/validate] [:db/add "7696509d-e5cb-5529-a8eb-a961ebd3df4c" :question/id #uuid "7696509d-e5cb-5529-a8eb-a961ebd3df4c"] [:db/add "7696509d-e5cb-5529-a8eb-a961ebd3df4c" :question/problem "Find an antiderivative.

$$
\frac{u-1}{u}=1-\frac{1}{u}.

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int \frac{3 \tan{\left(x \right)} \sec^{2}{\left(x \right)}}{\sec{\left(x \right)} + 1}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=3\left(\int 1 - \frac{1}{u}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Integrate with respect to $u$:

$$
3\left(\int 1 - \frac{1}{u}\,\mathrm{d}u\right)=3\left(u-\ln\left|u\right|\right)+C.
$$

Substitute back:

$$
3\left(\sec{\left(x \right)} + 1-\ln\left|\sec{\left(x \right)} + 1\right|\right)+C.
$$"] [:db/add "925407a6-15df-507e-b702-30c13be91427" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/hard] [:db/add "925407a6-15df-507e-b702-30c13be91427" :question/answer-fields "bc24d8c1-2dba-5a15-86c1-7b8a92a86f17"] [:db/ensure "925407a6-15df-507e-b702-30c13be91427" :question/validate] [:db/add 17592186068918 :knowledge-point/questions "925407a6-15df-507e-b702-30c13be91427"] [:db/add "0b7887f9-f432-51a2-b303-334d07b2cba3" :answer/id #uuid "0b7887f9-f432-51a2-b303-334d07b2cba3"] [:db/add "0b7887f9-f432-51a2-b303-334d07b2cba3" :answer/type :answer.type/math] [:db/add "0b7887f9-f432-51a2-b303-334d07b2cba3" :answer/value "\frac{1}{2}\left(\ln\left|\sin{\left(x^{2} \right)} + 3\right|\right)"] [:db/ensure "0b7887f9-f432-51a2-b303-334d07b2cba3" :answer/validate] [:db/add "35ed0262-5b26-5a59-a1ca-1e9767a0763a" :answer-field/id #uuid "35ed0262-5b26-5a59-a1ca-1e9767a0763a"] [:db/add "35ed0262-5b26-5a59-a1ca-1e9767a0763a" :answer-field/key "answer"] [:db/add "35ed0262-5b26-5a59-a1ca-1e9767a0763a" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/blank] [:db/add "35ed0262-5b26-5a59-a1ca-1e9767a0763a" :answer-field/choices "0b7887f9-f432-51a2-b303-334d07b2cba3"] [:db/add "35ed0262-5b26-5a59-a1ca-1e9767a0763a" :answer-field/correct "0b7887f9-f432-51a2-b303-334d07b2cba3"] [:db/ensure "35ed0262-5b26-5a59-a1ca-1e9767a0763a" :answer-field/validate] [:db/add "e8649475-994f-54e3-8796-29f4ecd57606" :question/id #uuid "e8649475-994f-54e3-8796-29f4ecd57606"] [:db/add "e8649475-994f-54e3-8796-29f4ecd57606" :question/problem "Find an antiderivative.

{{answer}}"] [:db/add "62ce3275-2baa-559b-b2b1-d066e2b0c811" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=\sin^{2}{\left(x \right)} + 1$. Then

$$
\frac{\mathrm{d}u}{\mathrm{d}x}=2 \sin{\left(x \right)} \cos{\left(x \right)}.
$$

Transform both bounds:

$$
\begin{aligned}x=0&\Longrightarrow u=1\\x=\frac{\pi}{2}&\Longrightarrow u=2\end{aligned}
$$

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \frac{2 \sin{\left(x \right)} \cos{\left(x \right)}}{\sin^{2}{\left(x \right)} + 1}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\int_{1}^{2} \frac{1}{u}\,\mathrm{d}u.\end{aligned}
$$

Both transformed bounds are positive. Evaluating gives

$$
\left[\ln u\right]_{1}^{2}=\ln\left(2\right)-\ln\left(1\right).
$$

The answer is

$$
\ln\left(2\right)-\ln\left(1\right).
$$"] [:db/add "62ce3275-2baa-559b-b2b1-d066e2b0c811" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/hard] [:db/add "62ce3275-2baa-559b-b2b1-d066e2b0c811" :question/answer-fields "d8fe7e48-e89b-5110-9b40-2a3e19531370"] [:db/ensure "62ce3275-2baa-559b-b2b1-d066e2b0c811" :question/validate] [:db/add 17592186068918 :knowledge-point/questions "62ce3275-2baa-559b-b2b1-d066e2b0c811"] [:db/add "89ccb77f-ea19-5517-a80b-5775b27f0059" :answer/id #uuid "89ccb77f-ea19-5517-a80b-5775b27f0059"] [:db/add "89ccb77f-ea19-5517-a80b-5775b27f0059" :answer/type :answer.type/math] [:db/add "89ccb77f-ea19-5517-a80b-5775b27f0059" :answer/value "-\left(\ln\left(2\right)-\ln\left(3\right)\right)"] [:db/ensure "89ccb77f-ea19-5517-a80b-5775b27f0059" :answer/validate] [:db/add "a2f382a7-7017-56d3-989d-72bb9b1a4196" :answer-field/id #uuid "a2f382a7-7017-56d3-989d-72bb9b1a4196"] [:db/add "a2f382a7-7017-56d3-989d-72bb9b1a4196" :answer-field/key "answer"] [:db/add "a2f382a7-7017-56d3-989d-72bb9b1a4196" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/blank] [:db/add "a2f382a7-7017-56d3-989d-72bb9b1a4196" :answer-field/choices "89ccb77f-ea19-5517-a80b-5775b27f0059"] [:db/add "a2f382a7-7017-56d3-989d-72bb9b1a4196" :answer-field/correct "89ccb77f-ea19-5517-a80b-5775b27f0059"] [:db/ensure "a2f382a7-7017-56d3-989d-72bb9b1a4196" :answer-field/validate] [:db/add "ef2b20da-499d-545a-b464-cf852a7c9a60" :question/id #uuid "ef2b20da-499d-545a-b464-cf852a7c9a60"] [:db/add "ef2b20da-499d-545a-b464-cf852a7c9a60" :question/problem "Evaluate exactly.

$$

$$

You may use $\int 1/u\,\mathrm{d}u=\ln\left|u\right|+C$.

Endpoint values: $\cos{\left(0 \right)}=1,\quad \cos{\left(\frac{\pi}{2} \right)}=0$.

{{answer}}"] [:db/add "ef2b20da-499d-545a-b464-cf852a7c9a60" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=\cos^{3}{\left(x \right)} + 2$. Then

$$
\frac{\mathrm{d}u}{\mathrm{d}x}=- 3 \sin{\left(x \right)} \cos^{2}{\left(x \right)}.
$$

Transform both bounds:

$$
\begin{aligned}x=0&\Longrightarrow u=3\\x=\frac{\pi}{2}&\Longrightarrow u=2\end{aligned}
$$

The new bounds decrease. Keep this order when evaluating the antiderivative.

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \frac{3 \sin{\left(x \right)} \cos^{2}{\left(x \right)}}{\cos^{3}{\left(x \right)} + 2}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=-\left(\int_{3}^{2} \frac{1}{u}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Both transformed bounds are positive. Evaluating gives

$$
-\left(\left[\ln u\right]_{3}^{2}\right)=-\left(\ln\left(2\right)-\ln\left(3\right)\right).
$$

The answer is

$$
-\left(\ln\left(2\right)-\ln\left(3\right)\right).
$$"] [:db/add "ef2b20da-499d-545a-b464-cf852a7c9a60" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/hard] [:db/add "ef2b20da-499d-545a-b464-cf852a7c9a60" :question/answer-fields "a2f382a7-7017-56d3-989d-72bb9b1a4196"] [:db/ensure "ef2b20da-499d-545a-b464-cf852a7c9a60" :question/validate] [:db/add 17592186068918 :knowledge-point/questions "ef2b20da-499d-545a-b464-cf852a7c9a60"] [:db/add "a498463e-efb3-52d7-aba4-90b784066259" :answer/id #uuid "a498463e-efb3-52d7-aba4-90b784066259"] [:db/add "a498463e-efb3-52d7-aba4-90b784066259" :answer/type :answer.type/math] [:db/add "a498463e-efb3-52d7-aba4-90b784066259" :answer/value "\ln\left|\tan{\left(x^{2} \right)} + 2\right|"] [:db/ensure "a498463e-efb3-52d7-aba4-90b784066259" :answer/validate] [:db/add "567efca9-1396-52a6-9c25-b5fc3c639dce" :answer-field/id #uuid "567efca9-1396-52a6-9c25-b5fc3c639dce"] [:db/add "567efca9-1396-52a6-9c25-b5fc3c639dce" :answer-field/key "answer"] [:db/add "567efca9-1396-52a6-9c25-b5fc3c639dce" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/blank] [:db/add "567efca9-1396-52a6-9c25-b5fc3c639dce" :answer-field/choices "a498463e-efb3-52d7-aba4-90b784066259"] [:db/add "567efca9-1396-52a6-9c25-b5fc3c639dce" :answer-field/correct "a498463e-efb3-52d7-aba4-90b784066259"] [:db/ensure "567efca9-1396-52a6-9c25-b5fc3c639dce" :answer-field/validate] [:db/add "5799d41a-2cfa-514c-bee4-deec7f0746d9" :question/id #uuid "5799d41a-2cfa-514c-bee4-deec7f0746d9"] [:db/add "5799d41a-2cfa-514c-bee4-deec7f0746d9" :question/problem "Find an antiderivative.

$$
\int \frac{2 x \sec^{2}{\left(x^{2} \right)}}{\tan{\left(x^{2} \right)} + 2}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

You may use $\int 1/u\,\mathrm{d}u=\ln\left|u\right|+C$.

{{answer}} $+C$"] [:db/add "5799d41a-2cfa-514c-bee4-deec7f0746d9" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=\tan{\left(x^{2} \right)} + 2$. Then

$$
\frac{\mathrm{d}u}{\mathrm{d}x}=2 x \sec^{2}{\left(x^{2} \right)}.
$$

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int \frac{2 x \sec^{2}{\left(x^{2} \right)}}{\tan{\left(x^{2} \right)} + 2}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\int \frac{1}{u}\,\mathrm{d}u.\end{aligned}
$$

Integrate with respect to $u$:

$$
\int \frac{1}{u}\,\mathrm{d}u=\ln\left|u\right|+C.
$$

Substitute back:

$$
\ln\left|\tan{\left(x^{2} \right)} + 2\right|+C.
$$"] [:db/add "5799d41a-2cfa-514c-bee4-deec7f0746d9" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/hard] [:db/add "5799d41a-2cfa-514c-bee4-deec7f0746d9" :question/answer-fields "567efca9-1396-52a6-9c25-b5fc3c639dce"] [:db/ensure "5799d41a-2cfa-514c-bee4-deec7f0746d9" :question/validate] [:db/add 17592186068918 :knowledge-point/questions "5799d41a-2cfa-514c-bee4-deec7f0746d9"] [:db/add "50065767-b289-53fe-a618-d57bf652d952" :answer/id #uuid "50065767-b289-53fe-a618-d57bf652d952"] [:db/add "50065767-b289-53fe-a618-d57bf652d952" :answer/type :answer.type/math] [:db/add "50065767-b289-53fe-a618-d57bf652d952" :answer/value "\sec{\left(x \right)} + 3-3\left(\ln\left|\sec{\left(x \right)} + 3\right|\right)"] [:db/ensure "50065767-b289-53fe-a618-d57bf652d952" :answer/validate] [:db/add "22f19925-f30d-5472-9d85-cbeba2358e50" :answer-field/id #uuid "22f19925-f30d-5472-9d85-cbeba2358e50"] [:db/add "22f19925-f30d-5472-9d85-cbeba2358e50" :answer-field/key "answer"] [:db/add "22f19925-f30d-5472-9d85-cbeba2358e50" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/blank] [:db/add "22f19925-f30d-5472-9d85-cbeba2358e50" :answer-field/choices "50065767-b289-53fe-a618-d57bf652d952"] [:db/add "22f19925-f30d-5472-9d85-cbeba2358e50" :answer-field/correct "50065767-b289-53fe-a618-d57bf652d952"] [:db/ensure "22f19925-f30d-5472-9d85-cbeba2358e50" :answer-field/validate] [:db/add "f6d82a54-5d2e-504b-a04e-946dd548ece7" :question/id #uuid "f6d82a54-5d2e-504b-a04e-946dd548ece7"] [:db/add "f6d82a54-5d2e-504b-a04e-946dd548ece7" :question/problem "Find an antiderivative.

$$
\int \frac{\tan{\left(x \right)} \sec^{2}{\left(x \right)}}{\sec{\left(x \right)} + 3}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

You may use $\int 1/u\,\mathrm{d}u=\ln\left|u\right|+C$.

{{answer}} $+C$"] [:db/add "f6d82a54-5d2e-504b-a04e-946dd548ece7" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=\sec{\left(x \right)} + 3$. Then

$$
\frac{\mathrm{d}u}{\mathrm{d}x}=\tan{\left(x \right)} \sec{\left(x \right)}.
$$

Since $\sec{\left(x \right)}=u-3$, rewrite the remaining factor:

$$
\frac{u-3}{u}=1-\frac{3}{u}.
$$

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int \frac{\tan{\left(x \right)} \sec^{2}{\left(x \right)}}{\sec{\left(x \right)} + 3}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\int 1 - \frac{3}{u}\,\mathrm{d}u.\end{aligned}
$$

Integrate with respect to $u$:

$$
\int 1 - \frac{3}{u}\,\mathrm{d}u=u-3\left(\ln\left|u\right|\right)+C.
$$

Substitute back:

$$
\sec{\left(x \right)} + 3-3\left(\ln\left|\sec{\left(x \right)} + 3\right|\right)+C.
$$"] [:db/add "f6d82a54-5d2e-504b-a04e-946dd548ece7" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/hard] [:db/add "f6d82a54-5d2e-504b-a04e-946dd548ece7" :question/answer-fields "22f19925-f30d-5472-9d85-cbeba2358e50"] [:db/ensure "f6d82a54-5d2e-504b-a04e-946dd548ece7" :question/validate] [:db/add 17592186068918 :knowledge-point/questions "f6d82a54-5d2e-504b-a04e-946dd548ece7"] [:db/add "generator" :question-generator/id #uuid "d4269f3a-b357-54c0-8e94-27f039c3b613"] [:db/add "generator" :question-generator/script "generators/b4/b4a1184baf1a0c145e71bb92ddcd6462ad4ceafcca3d350d16bc0ec0ea18f5ad/generator.py"] [:db/add 17592186068918 :knowledge-point/question-generator "generator"] [:db/ensure 17592186068918 :knowledge-point/validate] [:db/cas 17592186677532 :question/retired nil true] [:db/cas 17592186677534 :question/retired nil true] [:db/cas 17592186677538 :question/retired nil true] [:db/cas 17592186677541 :question/retired nil true] [:db/cas 17592186677542 :question/retired nil true] [:db/cas 17592186677546 :question/retired nil true] [:db/cas 17592186677547 :question/retired nil true] [:db/cas 17592186677553 :question/retired nil true] [:db/cas 17592186677558 :question/retired nil true] [:db/cas 17592186677561 :question/retired nil true] [:db/cas 17592186677565 :question/retired nil true] [:db/cas 17592186677566 :question/retired nil true] [:db/cas 17592186677567 :question/retired nil true] [:db/cas 17592186677572 :question/retired nil true] [:db/cas 17592186677574 :question/retired nil true] [:db/cas 17592186677579 :question/retired nil true] [:db/cas 17592186677582 :question/retired nil true] [:db/cas 17592186677585 :question/retired nil true] [:db/cas 17592186677587 :question/retired nil true] [:db/cas 17592186677589 :question/retired nil true] [:db/cas 17592186677592 :question/retired nil true] [:db/cas 17592186677594 :question/retired nil true] [:db/cas 17592186677599 :question/retired nil true] [:db/cas 17592186677603 :question/retired nil true]]

$$
\int \frac{3 \sin{\left(x \right)}}{\cos{\left(x \right)} + 2}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$"] [:db/add "27c56402-ae7c-5947-a07d-e1f38c987e3b" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=\cos{\left(x \right)} + 2$. Then

$$

$$

The transformed integral is

$$
-3\left(\int \frac{1}{u}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).
$$"] [:db/add "27c56402-ae7c-5947-a07d-e1f38c987e3b" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/easy] [:db/add "27c56402-ae7c-5947-a07d-e1f38c987e3b" :question/answer-fields $$
\int \frac{3 \sin{\left(x \right)}}{\cos{\left(x \right)} + 2}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

You may use $\int 1/u\,\mathrm{d}u=\ln\left|u\right|+C$.

{{answer}} $+C$"] [:db/add "bfed7b75-cd14-5de2-9aa5-2a0b83a01ce0" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=\cos{\left(x \right)} + 2$. Then

$$
\frac{\mathrm{d}u}{\mathrm{d}x}=- \sin{\left(x \right)}.
$$

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int \frac{3 \sin{\left(x \right)}}{\cos{\left(x \right)} + 2}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=-3\left(\int \frac{1}{u}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Integrate with respect to $u$:

$$
-3\left(\int \frac{1}{u}\,\mathrm{d}u\right)=-3\left(\ln\left|u\right|\right)+C.
$$

Substitute back:

{{answer}} $+C$"] [:db/add "80d4ee8f-50d5-560e-99ae-11b6253219c3" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=\tan{\left(x^{2} \right)} + 1$. Then

$$
\frac{\mathrm{d}u}{\mathrm{d}x}=2 x \sec^{2}{\left(x^{2} \right)}.

$$
\int \frac{3 \tan{\left(x \right)} \sec^{2}{\left(x \right)}}{\sec{\left(x \right)} + 1}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

You may use $\int 1/u\,\mathrm{d}u=\ln\left|u\right|+C$.

{{answer}} $+C$"] [:db/add "925407a6-15df-507e-b702-30c13be91427" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=\sec{\left(x \right)} + 1$. Then

$$
\frac{\mathrm{d}u}{\mathrm{d}x}=\tan{\left(x \right)} \sec{\left(x \right)}.
$$

Since $\sec{\left(x \right)}=u-1$, rewrite the remaining factor:

$$
\frac{u-1}{u}=1-\frac{1}{u}.
$$

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int \frac{3 \tan{\left(x \right)} \sec^{2}{\left(x \right)}}{\sec{\left(x \right)} + 1}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=3\left(\int 1 - \frac{1}{u}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Integrate with respect to $u$:

$$
3\left(\int 1 - \frac{1}{u}\,\mathrm{d}u\right)=3\left(u-\ln\left|u\right|\right)+C.
$$

Substitute back:

$$
3\left(\sec{\left(x \right)} + 1-\ln\left|\sec{\left(x \right)} + 1\right|\right)+C.
$$"] [:db/add "925407a6-15df-507e-b702-30c13be91427" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/hard] [:db/add "925407a6-15df-507e-b702-30c13be91427" :question/answer-fields "bc24d8c1-2dba-5a15-86c1-7b8a92a86f17"] [:db/ensure "925407a6-15df-507e-b702-30c13be91427" :question/validate] [:db/add 17592186068918 :knowledge-point/questions "925407a6-15df-507e-b702-30c13be91427"] [:db/add "0b7887f9-f432-51a2-b303-334d07b2cba3" :answer/id #uuid "0b7887f9-f432-51a2-b303-334d07b2cba3"] [:db/add "0b7887f9-f432-51a2-b303-334d07b2cba3" :answer/type :answer.type/math] [:db/add "0b7887f9-f432-51a2-b303-334d07b2cba3" :answer/value "\frac{1}{2}\left(\ln\left|\sin{\left(x^{2} \right)} + 3\right|\right)"] [:db/ensure "0b7887f9-f432-51a2-b303-334d07b2cba3" :answer/validate] [:db/add "35ed0262-5b26-5a59-a1ca-1e9767a0763a" :answer-field/id #uuid "35ed0262-5b26-5a59-a1ca-1e9767a0763a"] [:db/add "35ed0262-5b26-5a59-a1ca-1e9767a0763a" :answer-field/key "answer"] [:db/add "35ed0262-5b26-5a59-a1ca-1e9767a0763a" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/blank] [:db/add "35ed0262-5b26-5a59-a1ca-1e9767a0763a" :answer-field/choices "0b7887f9-f432-51a2-b303-334d07b2cba3"] [:db/add "35ed0262-5b26-5a59-a1ca-1e9767a0763a" :answer-field/correct "0b7887f9-f432-51a2-b303-334d07b2cba3"] [:db/ensure "35ed0262-5b26-5a59-a1ca-1e9767a0763a" :answer-field/validate] [:db/add "e8649475-994f-54e3-8796-29f4ecd57606" :question/id #uuid "e8649475-994f-54e3-8796-29f4ecd57606"] [:db/add "e8649475-994f-54e3-8796-29f4ecd57606" :question/problem "Find an antiderivative.

You may use $\int 1/u\,\mathrm{d}u=\ln\left|u\right|+C$.

{{answer}} $+C$"] [:db/add "e8649475-994f-54e3-8796-29f4ecd57606" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=\sin{\left(x^{2} \right)} + 3$. Then

$$
\frac{\mathrm{d}u}{\mathrm{d}x}=2 x \cos{\left(x^{2} \right)}.
$$

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int \frac{x \cos{\left(x^{2} \right)}}{\sin{\left(x^{2} \right)} + 3}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\frac{1}{2}\left(\int \frac{1}{u}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Integrate with respect to $u$:

$$
\frac{1}{2}\left(\int \frac{1}{u}\,\mathrm{d}u\right)=\frac{1}{2}\left(\ln\left|u\right|\right)+C.
$$

Substitute back:

$$
\frac{1}{2}\left(\ln\left|\sin{\left(x^{2} \right)} + 3\right|\right)+C.
$$"] [:db/add "e8649475-994f-54e3-8796-29f4ecd57606" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/hard] [:db/add "e8649475-994f-54e3-8796-29f4ecd57606" :question/answer-fields "35ed0262-5b26-5a59-a1ca-1e9767a0763a"] [:db/ensure "e8649475-994f-54e3-8796-29f4ecd57606" :question/validate] [:db/add 17592186068918 :knowledge-point/questions "e8649475-994f-54e3-8796-29f4ecd57606"] [:db/add "5330c5f8-10e3-58c6-91a5-4dca22835059" :answer/id #uuid "5330c5f8-10e3-58c6-91a5-4dca22835059"] [:db/add "5330c5f8-10e3-58c6-91a5-4dca22835059" :answer/type :answer.type/math] [:db/add "5330c5f8-10e3-58c6-91a5-4dca22835059" :answer/value "\tan{\left(x \right)} + 3-3\left(\ln\left|\tan{\left(x \right)} + 3\right|\right)"] [:db/ensure "5330c5f8-10e3-58c6-91a5-4dca22835059" :answer/validate] [:db/add "53e8b1ed-c4bb-5483-ac19-99f71799dad5" :answer-field/id #uuid "53e8b1ed-c4bb-5483-ac19-99f71799dad5"] [:db/add "53e8b1ed-c4bb-5483-ac19-99f71799dad5" :answer-field/key "answer"] [:db/add "53e8b1ed-c4bb-5483-ac19-99f71799dad5" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/blank] [:db/add "53e8b1ed-c4bb-5483-ac19-99f71799dad5" :answer-field/choices "5330c5f8-10e3-58c6-91a5-4dca22835059"] [:db/add "53e8b1ed-c4bb-5483-ac19-99f71799dad5" :answer-field/correct "5330c5f8-10e3-58c6-91a5-4dca22835059"] [:db/ensure "53e8b1ed-c4bb-5483-ac19-99f71799dad5" :answer-field/validate] [:db/add "783c2a89-9f00-534b-8121-076b71f15964" :question/id #uuid "783c2a89-9f00-534b-8121-076b71f15964"] [:db/add "783c2a89-9f00-534b-8121-076b71f15964" :question/problem "Find an antiderivative.

$$

{{answer}} $+C$"] [:db/add "783c2a89-9f00-534b-8121-076b71f15964" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=\tan{\left(x \right)} + 3$. Then

$$
\frac{\mathrm{d}u}{\mathrm{d}x}=\sec^{2}{\left(x \right)}.
$$

Since $\tan{\left(x \right)}=u-3$, rewrite the remaining factor:

$$
\frac{u-3}{u}=1-\frac{3}{u}.
$$

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int \frac{\tan{\left(x \right)} \sec^{2}{\left(x \right)}}{\tan{\left(x \right)} + 3}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\int 1 - \frac{3}{u}\,\mathrm{d}u.\end{aligned}
$$

Integrate with respect to $u$:

$$
\int 1 - \frac{3}{u}\,\mathrm{d}u=u-3\left(\ln\left|u\right|\right)+C.
$$

Substitute back:

$$
\tan{\left(x \right)} + 3-3\left(\ln\left|\tan{\left(x \right)} + 3\right|\right)+C.
$$"] [:db/add "783c2a89-9f00-534b-8121-076b71f15964" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/hard] [:db/add "783c2a89-9f00-534b-8121-076b71f15964" :question/answer-fields "53e8b1ed-c4bb-5483-ac19-99f71799dad5"] [:db/ensure "783c2a89-9f00-534b-8121-076b71f15964" :question/validate] [:db/add 17592186068918 :knowledge-point/questions "783c2a89-9f00-534b-8121-076b71f15964"] [:db/add "cf96e8b8-c225-5478-b6ec-c2ab0af2d47d" :answer/id #uuid "cf96e8b8-c225-5478-b6ec-c2ab0af2d47d"] [:db/add "cf96e8b8-c225-5478-b6ec-c2ab0af2d47d" :answer/type :answer.type/math] [:db/add "cf96e8b8-c225-5478-b6ec-c2ab0af2d47d" :answer/value "\ln\left(2\right)-\ln\left(1\right)"] [:db/ensure "cf96e8b8-c225-5478-b6ec-c2ab0af2d47d" :answer/validate] [:db/add "d8fe7e48-e89b-5110-9b40-2a3e19531370" :answer-field/id #uuid "d8fe7e48-e89b-5110-9b40-2a3e19531370"] [:db/add "d8fe7e48-e89b-5110-9b40-2a3e19531370" :answer-field/key "answer"] [:db/add "d8fe7e48-e89b-5110-9b40-2a3e19531370" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/blank] [:db/add "d8fe7e48-e89b-5110-9b40-2a3e19531370" :answer-field/choices "cf96e8b8-c225-5478-b6ec-c2ab0af2d47d"] [:db/add "d8fe7e48-e89b-5110-9b40-2a3e19531370" :answer-field/correct "cf96e8b8-c225-5478-b6ec-c2ab0af2d47d"] [:db/ensure "d8fe7e48-e89b-5110-9b40-2a3e19531370" :answer-field/validate] [:db/add "62ce3275-2baa-559b-b2b1-d066e2b0c811" :question/id #uuid "62ce3275-2baa-559b-b2b1-d066e2b0c811"] [:db/add "62ce3275-2baa-559b-b2b1-d066e2b0c811" :question/problem "Evaluate exactly.

$$
\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \frac{2 \sin{\left(x \right)} \cos{\left(x \right)}}{\sin^{2}{\left(x \right)} + 1}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

You may use $\int 1/u\,\mathrm{d}u=\ln\left|u\right|+C$.

Endpoint values: $\sin{\left(0 \right)}=0,\quad \sin{\left(\frac{\pi}{2} \right)}=1$.

{{answer}}"] [:db/add "62ce3275-2baa-559b-b2b1-d066e2b0c811" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=\sin^{2}{\left(x \right)} + 1$. Then

$$
\frac{\mathrm{d}u}{\mathrm{d}x}=2 \sin{\left(x \right)} \cos{\left(x \right)}.
$$

Transform both bounds:

$$
\begin{aligned}x=0&\Longrightarrow u=1\\x=\frac{\pi}{2}&\Longrightarrow u=2\end{aligned}
$$

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \frac{2 \sin{\left(x \right)} \cos{\left(x \right)}}{\sin^{2}{\left(x \right)} + 1}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\int_{1}^{2} \frac{1}{u}\,\mathrm{d}u.\end{aligned}
$$

Both transformed bounds are positive. Evaluating gives

$$
\left[\ln u\right]_{1}^{2}=\ln\left(2\right)-\ln\left(1\right).
$$

The answer is

$$
\ln\left(2\right)-\ln\left(1\right).
$$"] [:db/add "62ce3275-2baa-559b-b2b1-d066e2b0c811" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/hard] [:db/add "62ce3275-2baa-559b-b2b1-d066e2b0c811" :question/answer-fields "d8fe7e48-e89b-5110-9b40-2a3e19531370"] [:db/ensure "62ce3275-2baa-559b-b2b1-d066e2b0c811" :question/validate] [:db/add 17592186068918 :knowledge-point/questions "62ce3275-2baa-559b-b2b1-d066e2b0c811"] [:db/add "89ccb77f-ea19-5517-a80b-5775b27f0059" :answer/id #uuid "89ccb77f-ea19-5517-a80b-5775b27f0059"] [:db/add "89ccb77f-ea19-5517-a80b-5775b27f0059" :answer/type :answer.type/math] [:db/add "89ccb77f-ea19-5517-a80b-5775b27f0059" :answer/value "-\left(\ln\left(2\right)-\ln\left(3\right)\right)"] [:db/ensure "89ccb77f-ea19-5517-a80b-5775b27f0059" :answer/validate] [:db/add "a2f382a7-7017-56d3-989d-72bb9b1a4196" :answer-field/id #uuid "a2f382a7-7017-56d3-989d-72bb9b1a4196"] [:db/add "a2f382a7-7017-56d3-989d-72bb9b1a4196" :answer-field/key "answer"] [:db/add "a2f382a7-7017-56d3-989d-72bb9b1a4196" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/blank] [:db/add "a2f382a7-7017-56d3-989d-72bb9b1a4196" :answer-field/choices "89ccb77f-ea19-5517-a80b-5775b27f0059"] [:db/add "a2f382a7-7017-56d3-989d-72bb9b1a4196" :answer-field/correct "89ccb77f-ea19-5517-a80b-5775b27f0059"] [:db/ensure "a2f382a7-7017-56d3-989d-72bb9b1a4196" :answer-field/validate] [:db/add "ef2b20da-499d-545a-b464-cf852a7c9a60" :question/id #uuid "ef2b20da-499d-545a-b464-cf852a7c9a60"] [:db/add "ef2b20da-499d-545a-b464-cf852a7c9a60" :question/problem "Evaluate exactly.

$$
\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \frac{3 \sin{\left(x \right)} \cos^{2}{\left(x \right)}}{\cos^{3}{\left(x \right)} + 2}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

You may use $\int 1/u\,\mathrm{d}u=\ln\left|u\right|+C$.

Endpoint values: $\cos{\left(0 \right)}=1,\quad \cos{\left(\frac{\pi}{2} \right)}=0$.

{{answer}}"] [:db/add "ef2b20da-499d-545a-b464-cf852a7c9a60" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=\cos^{3}{\left(x \right)} + 2$. Then

$$
\frac{\mathrm{d}u}{\mathrm{d}x}=- 3 \sin{\left(x \right)} \cos^{2}{\left(x \right)}.
$$

Transform both bounds:

$$
\begin{aligned}x=0&\Longrightarrow u=3\\x=\frac{\pi}{2}&\Longrightarrow u=2\end{aligned}
$$

The new bounds decrease. Keep this order when evaluating the antiderivative.

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \frac{3 \sin{\left(x \right)} \cos^{2}{\left(x \right)}}{\cos^{3}{\left(x \right)} + 2}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=-\left(\int_{3}^{2} \frac{1}{u}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Both transformed bounds are positive. Evaluating gives

$$
-\left(\left[\ln u\right]_{3}^{2}\right)=-\left(\ln\left(2\right)-\ln\left(3\right)\right).
$$

The answer is

$$

$$
\int \frac{\tan{\left(x \right)} \sec^{2}{\left(x \right)}}{\sec{\left(x \right)} + 3}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

{{answer}} $+C$"] [:db/add "f6d82a54-5d2e-504b-a04e-946dd548ece7" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=\sec{\left(x \right)} + 3$. Then

$$
\frac{\mathrm{d}u}{\mathrm{d}x}=\tan{\left(x \right)} \sec{\left(x \right)}.
$$

Since $\sec{\left(x \right)}=u-3$, rewrite the remaining factor:

$$
\frac{u-3}{u}=1-\frac{3}{u}.
$$

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int \frac{\tan{\left(x \right)} \sec^{2}{\left(x \right)}}{\sec{\left(x \right)} + 3}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\int 1 - \frac{3}{u}\,\mathrm{d}u.\end{aligned}
$$

Integrate with respect to $u$:

$$
\int 1 - \frac{3}{u}\,\mathrm{d}u=u-3\left(\ln\left|u\right|\right)+C.
$$

Substitute back:

$$
\sec{\left(x \right)} + 3-3\left(\ln\left|\sec{\left(x \right)} + 3\right|\right)+C.
$$"] [:db/add "f6d82a54-5d2e-504b-a04e-946dd548ece7" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/hard] [:db/add "f6d82a54-5d2e-504b-a04e-946dd548ece7" :question/answer-fields
